svg.title: Root stays inside the customer workload boundary
svg.desc: Place root authority wholly inside the customer workload, with intact platform and Hugging Face boundaries outside. Access to this island must not imply entry to either surrounding system. Use the independent customer workload inside intact platform geometry to identify this setting; keep the existing labels, qualifications and foreground relationships.

Use the independent customer workload inside intact platform geometry to identify this setting; keep the existing labels, qualifications and foreground relationships.", "lettering": [ { "box": [ 0.045, 0.78, 0.91, 0.18 ] } ], "lettering_mode": "manual", "nodes": [ { "asset": "customer-workload-field", "box": [ 0.0541, 0.0521, 0.5642, 0.539827 ], "color": "steel", "focus": true, "label": "MODAL PLATFORM INTACT", "label_box": [ 0.0541, 0.599927, 0.5642, 0.126957 ], "label_size": 18 }, { "asset": "scope-wide", "box": [ 0.1542, 0.2154, 0.364, 0.21087 ], "color": "claret", "focus": true, "label": "CUSTOMER WORKLOAD ROOT", "label_box": [ 0.1542, 0.43905, 0.364, 0.092655 ], "label_size": 18 }, { "asset": "gate", "box": [ 0.7275, 0.2225, 0.2184, 0.229614 ], "color": "steel", "focus": true, "label": "HUGGING FACE CLOSED", "label_box": [ 0.7275, 0.46603, 0.2184, 0.100891 ], "label_size": 18 } ], "reconstructed": false, "shot": "hero", "source": "
**Frame:** `11:34 UTC`. A root-level permission block illuminates inside the customer workload only. The outer Modal platform boundary remains intact and neutral. The isolated workload becomes a small steel-blue island outside OpenAI's evaluation boundary, with public reach and no direct path into Hugging Face.

**Action:** Root execution is confirmed, initially one command per submission.

**Caption:**
> ROOT INSIDE THE SANDBOX. NOT ROOT OF MODAL.
>
> CONTROL OF ONE SANDBOX CREATES A PLACE TO STAND.

**Provenance:** `documented` — bounded root access and timestamp from `OAI-TR`; platform non-compromise from `HF-TL`; the closing line is the project's statement of its instrumental function.

", "title": "Root stays inside the customer workload boundary" } }
